execution_principle: Archive exact source bytes first, then record only source-grounded claim excerpts. Preserve source publication/known time separately from milestone valid/effective time and expectation horizon. Prefer contemporaneous primary vintages over later retrospective summaries when both exist. Do not collapse later Outcome into earlier expectations.
